initial_objective: Development: add one backward-compatible CLI option
artifacts: focused regression test for omitted and enabled switch behavior
subagents: No; the change is narrow and tightly scoped.
safeguards: Capture baseline bytes before editing
Assert omitted-switch output and exit behavior are byte-for-byte unchanged
Test the new branch without broad snapshot churn

initial_objective: Testing: execute established unit checks and judge the release gate
transitions: Transition to Debugging only if the primary objective changes from gate assessment to explaining a product defect.
artifacts: No repository files unless the project requires a standard test report; preserve command output and environment evidence in the result
subagents: No; one authoritative test run and gate decision need consistent environment ownership.
safeguards: Use repository-defined commands and gate criteria
Distinguish product failures from unreachable-service infrastructure failures
Do not claim pass when required checks did not execute
Report blocked or failed exactly as the release policy defines

initial_objective: Debugging: establish the concurrency failure mechanism
transitions: After the mechanism and defect are proven, transition to Development for the repair; regression validation remains supporting work.
subagents: Conditionally use one read-only subagent to inspect concurrency paths or independent stress evidence; keep diagnosis and edits under one owner.
safeguards: Do not patch from correlation alone
Record timing, ownership, ordering, and synchronization evidence
Verify the fix removes the demonstrated race rather than masking frequency
Make the regression fail on the defect and pass repeatedly after repair

initial_objective: Review: assess correctness and backward compatibility
artifacts: Review findings only; no durable checkout changes
subagents: No unless the patch spans independently reviewable domains; any subagent remains read-only.
safeguards: Inspect diff and relevant contracts
Report only actionable, evidence-backed findings with locations and impact
Check old inputs, outputs, defaults, and error behavior
Leave the checkout unchanged

initial_objective: Performance: determine whether B improves p99 latency over A
transitions: Transition to Debugging only if benchmark validity or anomalous behavior becomes the primary objective.
subagents: No; both candidates must be measured under one controlled protocol.
safeguards: Use the identical replayable request stream and environment
Warm up consistently and randomize or alternate run order
Run enough repetitions for stable tail estimates
Check errors, throughput, throttling, and resource saturation
Claim improvement only when effect exceeds noise and uncertainty

initial_objective: Development: replace a shared tensor-memory contract across all consumers
artifacts: planner, transport, kernel, and backend migrations
subagents: Use read-only subagents only for consumer inventory or independent verification; tightly coupled implementation stays centrally coordinated.
safeguards: Map every producer, consumer, layout, dtype, shape, ownership, lifetime, and synchronization assumption first
Avoid compatibility wrappers unless a documented compatibility burden requires one
Prevent mixed old/new contract states
Verify all three backends plus planner, transport, kernel, and end-to-end paths

artifacts: No repository changes; return a lifecycle narrative or diagram with verified and unresolved branches labeled
subagents: No; lifecycle claims benefit from one coherent evidence chain.
safeguards: Trace acquisition, transfer, reuse, and release from call sites and state transitions
Cite concrete code evidence
Separate observed paths from inference
Mark unreachable, configuration-dependent, or unresolved branches explicitly
Make no edits

initial_objective: Testing: check the feature against its acceptance criterion
strategy_or_scale: VALIDATION with conditional diagnosis and repair
transitions: If and only if the criterion fails for an unknown cause, transition to Debugging to prove the cause
After proof, transition to Development for the supported repair
Return to Testing for authoritative reruns
artifacts: only on proven failure: minimal reproducer, supported repair, and regression test
subagents: No initially; consider a read-only diagnostic subagent only if the failing system has independently traceable components.
safeguards: Use the acceptance criterion and authoritative checks verbatim
Do not edit on pass or on a known external blocker
Do not repair before proving an unknown cause
Keep the repair within supported behavior
Rerun the focused regression and full authoritative checks after repair
